oxygen: The cubic feet of oxygen yearly swallowed by a full-grown man—what a shudder they might have created in some Middlemarch circles!

And strut upon my stem,
Disdaining men and oxygen,
For arrogance of them.
Body smells, body vapors, the room's need of oxygen--grew tense, exacting.

For all the rest of life.
Indebtedness to oxygen
The chemist may repay,
“Oxygen! nobody knows what that may be—is it any wonder the cholera has got to Dantzic?
oxy: Here would be another light, as of oxy-hydrogen, showing the very grain of things, and revising all former explanations.
